scientific_scope_status: Here audits are sacrificial TEST probes and USE calls carry real quantum payloads. Fresh uniform private two-bit Pauli masking of a qubit makes its entire accessible input I_D/2 tensor rho_ME, matching a uniform six-state test through the same complete physical call. Under trusted framing or trusted Bell preparation/terminal teleportation and retired fine records, direct masking and entanglement-first deferred use produce the same Pauli-labelled CP use maps and coarse per-axis pass/fail bath instruments, even for correlated input and memory. With genuine positive USE branches and a uniform operator lower bound on the actual test effect, a predictable private test coin supports an all-prefix virtual-fault budget with paid mismatch. Retaining individual detector outcomes can change future bath updates despite matching test failure rates. Complete-instrument substitution and the weaker effect-only budget therefore retain separate conditions; exposed/reused keys, unmatched ports or an untrusted final gate do not inherit either guarantee automatically.
